== Title ==
<span lang="ja">トーントーン</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">乗客を1名乗せられる。ホス上にのみ配備できるが、それ以降はどこに移動させてもよい。能力値＝1/4。リアクションとして戦闘から移動して逃げることができる。犠牲にする（ロストさせる）ことによって、乗客をそのターンの間「凍死」の影響を受けないようにすることができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ホスで最初に発見された土着生物。氷原を群れをなして移動する。気が短くて臆病。体表は猛烈な獣の臭いを放つ。反乱軍のパトロール用に飼いならされている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Tauntaun.

'''Lore''' — The first native creature found on Hoth. They travel the ice fields in herds. Short-tempered and timid. Their bodies give off a fierce animal smell. They have been tamed for Rebel patrols.

'''Game text''' — May carry 1 passenger. May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere after that. Ability equals 1/4. May move and flee from a battle as a reaction. You may sacrifice (lose) it to make the passenger immune to Exposure this turn.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed subtype is 乗用生物. Lore describes a fierce animal smell and taming for patrols; English jokes that they “smell bad on the outside” and were trained as steeds. Game text keeps “may move elsewhere,” uses リアクション, and names 「凍死」 for Exposure.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-tauntaun-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Tauntaun]].</ref>
